newsitem.title: INDIA: New arrivals drive down Indian castor prices.
newsitem.headline: New arrivals drive down Indian castor prices.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell on Thursday to 1,125/1,126 rupees from 1,131/1,132 on new crop arrivals and lower export buying, dealers said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region rose to 14/15,000 (75 kg each).
"Foreign buyers are seeking Indian castoroil at $650 per tonne while Indian offers were at $665/670," one operator said.
Groundnut oil remained steady at 343/344 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 50/60 tonnes while seasonal buying remained low. In Rajkot spot oil rose from 525 rupees to 530 rupees per 15 kg.
